    "evidence_types": [
      "Human genetics: the APP A673T variant protects against Alzheimer disease and age-related cognitive decline and reduces amyloidogenic processing (PMID:22801501).",
      "Randomized clinical trial: lecanemab, targeting APP-derived amyloid-beta protofibrils, slowed cognitive and functional decline in early amyloid-positive Alzheimer disease (PMID:36449413); this validates the cleavage-product pathway, not direct inhibition of full-length APP."
    ],
    "direction": "Selectively reduce pathogenic APP-derived amyloid-beta production or enhance aggregated amyloid-beta clearance while preserving physiological APP functions. Human cognitive benefit is demonstrated for amyloid-beta clearance with lecanemab in early amyloid-positive disease, not for direct full-length APP inhibition or all interventions that reduce amyloidogenic processing. Amyloid-related imaging abnormalities are a risk of the antibody approach."
  },

      "Human molecular imaging/pharmacodynamics: longitudinal PET measurements demonstrate that donepezil inhibits cerebral cortical acetylcholinesterase in Alzheimer patients (PMID:19935404), independently confirming central target engagement."
    ],
    "direction": "Partially inhibit central acetylcholinesterase enzymatic activity to increase synaptic acetylcholine and improve cognition symptomatically. Disease modification is not established; peripheral cholinergic adverse effects constrain inhibition."

      "Randomized clinical trial: lecanemab targeting APP-derived amyloid-beta protofibrils modestly slowed cognitive and functional decline in early Alzheimer disease (PMID:36449413). This supports the APP/amyloid pathway, not direct inhibition of full-length APP."

    "direction": "Reduce pathogenic APP-derived amyloid-beta production or enhance its clearance while preserving physiological APP function.
